legacy_behavior: Discount percentage rounded to one decimal
phase_2_behavior_and_reason: No public discount badge in this phase.
migration_or_user_impact: Frontend calculates only positive valid discount.

legacy_behavior: Zero price list renders contact text
phase_2_behavior_and_reason: CONTACT has null prices; cannot create free checkout.
migration_or_user_impact: Zero/unknown legacy pricing requires mapping review.

legacy_behavior: Stock label uses product sl==0
phase_2_behavior_and_reason: BUSINESS RULE CHANGE: row-locked physical/reserved/available stock; adjustments validated.
migration_or_user_impact: Do not trust legacy stock labels for cutover reconciliation.

legacy_behavior: Variant JSON arrays align by index
phase_2_behavior_and_reason: BUSINESS RULE CHANGE: relational option/value/variant/inventory rows.
migration_or_user_impact: Normalize aligned arrays and retain legacy metadata later.

legacy_behavior: Maximum two option groups in admin JavaScript
phase_2_behavior_and_reason: BUSINESS RULE CHANGE: up to ten configurable option groups; bounded generator.
migration_or_user_impact: Existing one/two groups supported; no hard-coded labels.

legacy_behavior: Cartesian product regenerated from option values
phase_2_behavior_and_reason: BUSINESS RULE CHANGE: generate missing combinations only; preserve IDs/SKU/price/stock.
migration_or_user_impact: Referenced values and group structure cannot be destructively rewritten.

legacy_behavior: Base SKU applies same value to every variant
phase_2_behavior_and_reason: BUSINESS RULE CHANGE: shared base SKU across variants forbidden; global unique SKU.
migration_or_user_impact: Keep legacy_sku separately in Phase 4; resolve duplicates.

legacy_behavior: Variant selected by exact pair not SKU
phase_2_behavior_and_reason: One value per product-owned option and unique combination.
migration_or_user_impact: Public selection endpoint deferred.

legacy_behavior: Variant prices overwrite hidden order field via AJAX
phase_2_behavior_and_reason: BUSINESS RULE CHANGE: order domain uses authoritative server pricing; admin cannot edit totals.
migration_or_user_impact: Legacy snapshots stay archival; no repricing historical orders.

legacy_behavior: Product gallery stored in order; variant images appended
phase_2_behavior_and_reason: BUSINESS RULE CHANGE: ordered gallery and owned SKU image via public storage, validated/re-encoded uploads.
migration_or_user_impact: Legacy file/path transform later; do not delete unreferenced archive files.

legacy_behavior: Slug fallback transliterates Vietnamese imperfectly
phase_2_behavior_and_reason: BUSINESS RULE CHANGE: normalized unique slug generator; admin can choose slug.
migration_or_user_impact: Preserve exact old URL redirects during import, no URLs changed now.

legacy_behavior: SEO fallback for product fields
phase_2_behavior_and_reason: Explicit product SEO fields and site default SEO settings editable.
migration_or_user_impact: Public fallback chain belongs to Phase 3.

legacy_behavior: One POST creates one order row with submitted snapshot
phase_2_behavior_and_reason: BUSINESS RULE CHANGE: Order plus immutable multi-item snapshots/history.
migration_or_user_impact: Legacy one-row requests use separate historical import path.

legacy_behavior: Legacy order status toggles0and1
phase_2_behavior_and_reason: BUSINESS RULE CHANGE: enum transitions, row lock, actor/time/note and expected status.
migration_or_user_impact: Legacy 0 NEW / 1 CONFIRMED remains proposed import policy.

legacy_behavior: Line total calculated from stored unit price times quantity
phase_2_behavior_and_reason: Stored integer unit price times quantity and immutable order totals/items.
migration_or_user_impact: Invalid old quantities/prices remain quarantine inputs, not live order updates.

legacy_behavior: Article views debounced by20minute cookie
phase_2_behavior_and_reason: No public article-view/cookie handler in Phase 2.
migration_or_user_impact: View_count is not fabricated in admin.

legacy_behavior: Popup hidden for365days
phase_2_behavior_and_reason: Popup position metadata supported; dismissal cookie UX not built.
migration_or_user_impact: Frontend UX decision later.

legacy_behavior: Banner placement filters a0/a1/a4
phase_2_behavior_and_reason: Unified Banner/Slider has configured positions/category scope/priority/sort/schedule.
migration_or_user_impact: Map a0/a1/a4 to approved positions during import.

legacy_behavior: Admin role guard admits1or3or5
phase_2_behavior_and_reason: BUSINESS RULE CHANGE: native Exment roles and module Gates replace legacy integer guards.
migration_or_user_impact: Legacy roles 1/2/3/4/5 require human identity review; no automatic grant.

legacy_behavior: Several mutations require only session name
phase_2_behavior_and_reason: BUSINESS RULE CHANGE: native user/role routes system-admin only; per-module and owner authorization.
migration_or_user_impact: No login-only privilege escalation.

legacy_behavior: Admin login MD5 and no status filter
phase_2_behavior_and_reason: BUSINESS RULE CHANGE: native bcrypt/history/reset and removed-login session revocation.
migration_or_user_impact: Never import MD5; provision/reset users in Phase 4.

legacy_behavior: Article updated timestamp overwritten
phase_2_behavior_and_reason: BUSINESS RULE CHANGE: created_at remains creation timestamp; published_at independent.
migration_or_user_impact: Cannot reconstruct original legacy dates; retain provenance.

legacy_behavior: Image removal from product form changes JSON only
phase_2_behavior_and_reason: BUSINESS RULE CHANGE: owned image delete is explicit, confirmed, FK guarded and file cleanup after commit.
